messages.subject: Accessing variables in server.R from UI.R
parts:
Hi All,

I am trying do some operations based on the user input. I am unable to access variables stored  in server.R from UI.R

I am basically trying to create a checkbox group based on some data uploaded through a excel file. Here is my code (I ma trying to accomplish something like the line highlighted in blue in UI.R

server.R


library(shiny)
library(XLConnect)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    output$sheet1 <- renderTable({
    inFile <- input$file1
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    test <- loadWorkbook(inFile$datapath)
    sheet1<- (readWorksheet(test,1)
    listsheet <- list(sheet1)
    return(sheet1)
  })
  
}) 

ui.R

tabPanel("Choose values",
                      titlePanel("Click on the values"),
                      fluidRow(
                        column(width = 3,
                               tags$hr(),
                             
                                                  
                               checkboxGroupInput("Values", 
                                   label = h3("Click on Values"), 
                                   choices =output()$listsheet,
                                   selected = 1)
                              
                       )

Thanks so much

messages.subject: Re: Accessing variables in server.R from UI.R
parts:
Ravi,

A couple of examples in the Shiny Gallery show this functionality:

http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/update-input-demo.html
http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/dynamic-ui.html

and also documentations on checkboxGroupInput and updateCheckboxGroupInput functions are helpful.

But a very short example, somewhat based on your code, is here:

server.R

library(shiny)
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  observe({
    c_num <- input$control_num
    cb_options <- list()
    cb_options[[paste("Option1", "A")]] <- paste0("optionA")
    cb_options[[paste("Option2", "B")]] <- paste0("optionB")
    cb_options[[paste("Option3", "C")]] <- paste0("optionC")
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "Values", choices = cb_options,
                             selected = paste0("optionA"))
  })
  
  output$option <- renderText({
    input$Values
  })
}) 

ui.R

library(shiny)
shinyUI(fluidPage(

tabPanel("Choose values",
           titlePanel("Click on the values"),
           fluidRow(
             column(width = 3,
                    tags$hr(),                    
                    checkboxGroupInput("Values", 
                                       label = h3("Click on Values"),

choices =c("A", "B", "C"),
                                       selected="A")                    
             )
           )
  ),
  tabPanel("output", verbatimTextOutput("option")) 
))

You can see that in server.R, a static list of cb_options is created. This is where you want to read values from excel and assign to the list.

Hope this helps,
Fereshteh
